framings.text: A human-first experience where you can guide work from intuition to a trustworthy, review-ready result while preserving codebase health and making future changes easier.

supports.quote: it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier.

framings.text: A durable coordination harness for the full agentic software-development lifecycle, designed to compound its own effectiveness while helping one person judge the final product.

supports.quote: a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness. its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle

outcome: You experience a coherent, rigorous, durable flow from an initial hunch to a delicious, trustworthy result ready for human review, with confidence that the codebase remains healthy and future work becomes easier.

questions.text: Should the primary success measure be your end-to-end reviewing experience, the system’s self-compounding capability, or both equally?

alternatives.label: Human-guided workflow with explicit checkpoints
alternatives.benefit: Keeps judgment, context, and final taste with the human while improving rigor and continuity.
alternatives.cost: Requires sustained human attention and clearly designed handoffs.

alternatives.label: Self-improving coordination harness
alternatives.benefit: Could compound process quality and coordinate more of the lifecycle over time.
alternatives.cost: Risks complexity, opacity, and drift from the human’s intended outcome.
